deviations.claim_in_article: “They enjoyed the ease of AI. But they did not know that a human was on the other end.”
deviations.issue: The article states as fact that users enjoyed the AI service and were unaware that a human handled the call. The Ledger supports that the test lacked adequate disclosure, but does not establish users’ actual awareness or enjoyment.
deviations.explanation: The definite claims about users’ experience and knowledge go beyond the Ledger; this is an unsupported addition and strengthens what is established about disclosure.
deviations.qualifier_text: “might think AI was doing it”; “If this was not explained clearly, users could not know if it was AI or a person.”
